svg.desc: Six diagnostic facets inside active step 23, not six new milestones. TARGET binds the retained intent-stage target and old-token possession through a bounded three-record selector. ACTOR supplies fresh WebAuthn, current roles and trust, configured approval, genuine options and a private live context. Both are source-landed in 9f036648f7fee2f88208a1e6b284b39c4acb08ee. AUTHORITY is source-green in 097ce540c69a3ba803d0a9bcfcba4710298427ed: independent original admission, active-context staging and same-PID resources, privilege drop and worker continuation. A staging ACK is not readiness, durable-store proof or token delivery. This source-defined byte bound is not a heap, RSS or runtime guarantee. Retained grants and canonical outcome reconstruction do not prove storage exists. That .208 checkpoint was private-only. Pre-send uncertainty preserves the existing cookie; no automatic retry. Failure after headers start remains an unknown outcome, without an undo or delivery guarantee. COMPLETE is active and partial in 0c4650c45c301c584b4ea89a223ef1294984a93f: the fresh consume-purpose private owner now signs with its dedicated caller, genuinely admits grant/reservation controls, claims the SQL slot before contact and genuinely admits completion after raw replies are retained. The .215 input-acquisition and prepare/export foundation is historical in 89365802ae5a5b7f7e97eb659166b20bc884671a. The same original work, bounded execution capacity and delivery expiry remain restrictive. This slice adds no public route, token or cookie. The retained-release RECOVERY/checkpoint-one branch in ee73c96d1683f51df756e64648f3249f1853b733 and LIVE/checkpoint-zero branch in d02c033f88c173a550bf96d5ba3fe9bfa17f32e7 remain distinct; their permissions are not reused.
